title: Machine learning and individual variability in electrical field characteristics predict tDCS treatment response for anxiety in older adults in the ACT trial.
summary: Machine learning and individualized electrical-field features predicted response to tDCS for anxiety in older adults in the ACT trial; the result is treatment-response prediction within the trial cohort.
